## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* meditation-liturgical manual by Zhìyǐ 智顗 on the *fāngděng sānmèi* 方等三昧 ("Vaipulya *samādhi*"), one of the **four kinds of *samādhi*** (*sì zhǒng sānmèi* 四種三昧) systematised by Zhìyǐ in the *Móhē zhǐguān* ([KR6d0130](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0130)).

**Abstract**

The *Fāngděng sānmèi xíngfǎ* belongs together with the *Fǎhuá sānmèi chànyí* ([KR6d0191](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0191)) and other Tiāntái meditation-liturgical manuals as the foundational liturgical apparatus of the Tiāntái meditative tradition. The composition is bracketed within Zhìyǐ's productive period c. 575–597.
